description: Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada publishes a dataset of water-chemistry measurements for the La Salle River near Elie, Manitoba, collected for the Red-Assiniboine modelling project. The provider gives coverage from August 2009 to October 2015 and reports total and dissolved nitrogen, total and dissolved phosphorus, and total suspended solids. Sampling ranges from multiple observations per week during high discharge in 2013–2015 to weekly or less frequent observations earlier and during low flows. CSV data and bilingual HTML dictionaries are available free under the Open Government Licence - Canada. These observations can calibrate nutrient-transport and catchment water-quality simulations relevant to treatment loads and agricultural runoff management. They complement the separate La Salle weather and discharge deposits. A limitation is that uneven sampling restricts direct comparison of annual loads and requires explicit interpolation assumptions. The provider period takes precedence over the shorter period stated in the article abstract.
